subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost opening handshakes use a fixed 30-second cutoff before reconnecting?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but selecting the cutoff deliberately trades indefinite hangs for reconnect churn on exceptionally slow servers or proxies.

options.title: Approve 30 seconds
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and land the proven fixed timeout without adding configuration surface.

options.title: Choose another fixed budget
options.body: Set an owner-approved timeout and rerun the hanging-peer and reconnect proof at that value.

options.title: Pause for policy design
options.body: Hold the PR only if Mattermost needs a broader configurable or adaptive connection-timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Approve 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and land the proven fixed timeout without adding configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged reconnect implementation and close-before-open behavior establish the owner boundary affected by this timeout.
